titel: Aydin Mirzaee Fellow.app - AI Agents That 10x Your Productivity | EP 141

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: How Fellow AI transformed from a manager tool into an eight-figure AI meeting assistant
kurzfassung: Aydin Mirzaee shares the journey of pivoting Fellow AI during the ChatGPT boom, scaling to eight figures in AI revenue. The conversation explores proactive meeting agents, real-time collaboration tools, and the future of AI-driven productivity. They also discuss integrations like MCPs that allow developers and teams to bridge meeting context directly into action.
stichpunkte: Pivoting Fellow AI after the 2022 ChatGPT launch helped scale the company to eight figures in AI revenue.
The platform offers multiple modalities, including bot-free recording where both parties are aware, avoiding secretive surveillance.
Fellow functions as a collaborative environment ensuring teams work off the same single list of action items.
Real-time features include a live debate assistant that provides attack vectors, counterpoints, and smart follow-up questions.
The product aims to act as an always-on chief of staff for pre-meeting prep and post-meeting automation.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations enable tools like Cursor to consume meeting context and execute code or tasks automatically.
Capturing meeting context transforms conversations into reusable company knowledge for wikis, CRMs, and tickets.

In this episode of the AI Agents Podcast, host Demetri Panici sits down with Aidan Mirza, founder and CEO of Fellow, to explore how AI is transforming meetings into actionable organizational intelligence. Aidan shares the story behind Fellow’s evolution from a meeting management platform into an AI-powered workplace assistant that helps teams prepare better, capture context, automate workflows, and execute on decisions faster.
They also dive into proactive AI, MCP integrations, meeting automation, AI-powered productivity, and the future of organizations where conversations become reusable knowledge. If you want to understand how AI is changing meetings, collaboration, and workplace efficiency, this episode is worth watching.
